newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE wheat and barley futures close mixed.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE wheat and barley futures close mixed.

text.p: LIFFE grain futures finished a fairly active session mixed with wheat supported mainly by short covering.
Strong sterling kept the pressure on wheat futures during early trading, but later the market rallied on shortcovering to end mixed.
Wheat closed 0.25 stg up to 0.20 stg down after trading 487 lots.
Most active May last traded at 96.10 stg, 0.25 stg down with 183 lots traded.
Barley closed lower at 0.35 to 0.05 stg down on a turnover of 46 lots.
The most active month, March had a last trade of 92.50 stg, 0.25 stg lower with 18 lots traded.
